title: 马赛克壁画
prompt: A mosaic mural of a [subject], crafted from chipped ceramic and glass shards in sun-faded [color1] and weathered [color2]. Set into a cracked plaster wall, the irregular shapes and grout lines add a rustic, timeworn charm.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，打造复古马赛克壁画，以碎裂陶瓷和玻璃碎片在褪色色调中呈现，为室内设计或商业空间增添质朴、时光沉淀的魅力。
